description: This Java class implements the 'If-None-Match' precondition header used in HTTP requests, specifically handling entity tags (ETags) to determine whether a request meets certain cache validation criteria as per RFC7232.

classes.name: IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader
classes.description: A class representing the HTTP 'If-None-Match' precondition header, used to match entity tags with incoming HTTP requests to facilitate cache validation and conditional requests.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the header key string for 'If-None-Match', used in HTTP headers.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity tags to match, as used in the HTTP header value.

methods.name: meetsConditionFor
methods.description: Determines if the given entity tag meets the 'If-None-Match' condition, based on weak match comparison.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Static method to extract an instance of 'IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader' from DittoHeaders if present.
